name: ANSI/IEEE Six-phase star winding connection form
summary: IEEE-library form of six-phase star winding connection: this qualifier identifies a six-phase winding connected at a common star point.
description: This reference locates six-phase star winding connection in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented winding family. This qualifier identifies a six-phase winding connected at a common star point. The public library uses Q060212 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace each winding, supply and accessible neutral through the complete machine or transformer connection diagram. Keep the phase arrangement, terminal labels and any clock notation attached to the device; neither the convention label nor this educational outline supplies its ratings.
